headline: Godcrofts Ruins Pass to Colonials as Wardens Gain in Weathered Expanse
war_summary: The ledger has turned since our last edition: the Wardens' strongpoints rise from 155 to 158 while the Colonials' count slips to 278, and no-man's-land has vanished from the map — both ruined works in Godcrofts are back under Colonial colors after twenty-four recorded actions about Ursa Base, Fleecewatch and Isawa, the last flags changing scarce five minutes before press time. Weathered Expanse remains the storm-center with fifty-five actions in the day, Wightwalk and Frostmarch busiest, and its flags now stand six Wardens to three Colonials, a marked swing, though its hourly losses are cooling from terrible heights. The Dead Lands have stirred afresh about The Salt March and Callahan's Boot, Warden losses running the heavier; Stlican Shelf's pace quickens on both sides at Breaker Town and The Pale House; Linn of Mercy slackens despite a day's toll near eighteen thousand. Callahan's Passage, lately so bloody, has fallen almost silent. It is day 200; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and neither side is named victor.
